notes: Plan positions from fig. 111 (p. 213). The entry's map ref (2008/1763) equals the unit point. I put it at the centroid of the complex, meaning the courtyard/pen between the cave cliff and the curved wall (plan px 263,503). The north arrow is measured at about 15 deg W of page-up (the extractor said 'very slightly W'); bearings are corrected for this. Scale bar 0-12 m = 86 px. The text says 'many cave openings', most of them shallow, with the two middle ones large and deep (probably s2f2-s2f3). Only the four caves labelled on the plan are coded. Sensitivity: with any centre inside the complex, or the centre of all drawn remains, s2f1 stays at 321-349 deg. s2f2 drops out of the sector (about 303 deg) if the centre moves east to include the slope remains. The burial cave is coded only as a grave. The text puts it 'at the southern side of the complex', and the plan agrees. The courtyard/pen is not a pool. 'Cisterns: none' is recorded as a C2 absence statement, although caves (pits) are present.
